title: start
body:
<<img, "assets/images/backgrounds/outdoor.png">>
<<character, show, template-male>>
A character enters the scene with a short slide and fade.
[[Continue|expression]]

title: expression
body:
<<character, show, template-male, excited>>
Showing the same character with another expression swaps the image in place.
[[Continue|indoors]]

title: indoors
body:
<<img, "assets/images/backgrounds/indoor.png">>
<<character, show, template-male, default, left>>
The background changes to a second location.
The character moves to the left side of the screen.
[[Continue|secondCharacter]]

title: secondCharacter
body:
<<character, show, template-female, default, right>>
A second character enters. Characters stay on screen until a passage hides them.
Pick a link. Each one leads to its own passage.
[[The first link|firstChoice]]
[[The second link|secondChoice]]

title: firstChoice
body:
<<character, show, template-male, excited>>
You picked the first link. Both links lead on to the same passage.
[[Continue|badge]]

title: secondChoice
body:
<<character, show, template-female, excited>>
You picked the second link. Both links lead on to the same passage.
[[Continue|badge]]

title: badge
body:
<<addItem, badge>>
<<character, show, template-male, default>>
<<character, show, template-female, excited>>
template-female gives you a badge. addItem puts it in your inventory: open it with I or the button in the corner.
[[Continue|badgeLinks]]

title: badgeLinks
body:
<<character, show, template-female, default>>
<<if $inventory.badge>>
The next link only shows while the badge is in your inventory.
[[Give the badge back|giveBadge]]
<<else>>
You gave the badge back, so its link is gone.
<<end>>
[[Play the minigame|minigame]]

title: giveBadge
body:
<<removeItem, badge>>
You give the badge back. removeItem takes it out of your inventory.
[[Go back|badgeLinks]]

title: minigame
body:
A minigame runs inside a passage. Hit as many targets as you can.
<<minigame, targetPractice>>
The round is over.
[[See the result|result]]

title: result
body:
<<if $targetGoalReached == true>>
<<character, show, template-male, excited>>
<<money, 50>>
You reached the goal with $targetHits hits. The money command pays you $ 50, so watch the money in the corner.
<<else>>
You missed the goal with $targetHits hits.
<<end>>
The passage reads the result from the targetHits and targetGoalReached variables.
[[Continue|ending]]

title: ending
body:
<<character, hide, template-male>>
<<character, hide, template-female>>
Hiding a character fades it out. This is the end of the showcase.
[[Start again|start]]
